[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Cliffs of Dohjok | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=432 }} The [[Cliffs of Dohjok]] is a forested ridge situated in southern Istan, between the swampy lowlands to the southwest and the flat plains to the east. A beautiful waterfall lies to the west. [[Istani]]s are currently carrying out quarrying work in the cliffs to the east of the waterfall. ==Getting there== The Cliffs of Dohjok connects to quite a few other locations. The fastest way is to travel southwest from [[Sunspear Great Hall]] to [[Champion's Dawn]], which also exits onto the eastern edge of the Cliffs of Dohjok. Nightfall characters will be led through here as part of the quest [[Leaving a Legacy]]. [[primary quest]] [[Leaving a Legacy]] (the one where you get [[Dunkoro]]) will allow you to clear this area quickly and safely, since you get the help of Dunkoro and a group of [[Digger]]s as allies. The bonus from bounties will give quite a bit of [[experience]]. To get even more, flag any [[hero]] and [[henchmen]] far away and just clear the area with Dunkoro and the Diggers, so that you will get the full amount of experience per kill. *There are several quests here which involve friendly NPCs who follow you around and body block for you during combat - Dalz Jelon, Mofuun, Dajwa. Since it's possible to have more than one of these NPCs active at one time, this effect can help someone going for the [[Survivor]] title. *There is no bounty on the [[corsair]]s in this area. *Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.5% to the Elonian [[Cartographer]] title track. *{{Vanquisher|count = 121|low = 113|high = 201}} **Leaving a Legacy produces the lowest amount of creatures as no corsairs spawn on the beach. **Consider starting from [[Beknur Harbor]] or [[Blacktide Den (outpost)|Blacktide Den]] for a party size of 8 instead of 4. **A few [[Skale]] groups to the east of the quarry area have large [[patrol]] routes and may easily be missed. **The quest [[Skree Hatchling Season]] in particular will produce a lot more foes. {{Explorable areas in Istan}} [[Category:Has Sunspear bounties]] [[de:Felsen von Dohjok]]
